notes.title: Pestilence Demo is OUT
notes.content:
The Demo is Live — Will You Escape the Shadows?

We're thrilled to announce that the demo for Pestilence is now available to play!
Dive into a dark, atmospheric world where the past haunts every corner and the truth waits in shadows.

This psychological horror experience will take you through:

A mysterious safehouse full of hidden memories

Unnerving environments and chilling soundscapes

Puzzles that unravel a forgotten story

Your mind may betray you.
Your memories may lie.
But the house remembers everything.

🎮 Download the demo now and tell us what you think!
Join the conversation, share your experience, and wishlist the full game here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3579380/Pestilence_Demo/
